You are working in C:\Users\edmem\kodely-prod (Next.js 16.3.1, React 19, Tailwind v4, TypeScript strict).

Six agents just built the customer portal in parallel against a shared design system. They could not see each other's work. Your job is the **integration and consistency pass** — the thing that no individual agent could do.

READ FIRST:
1. `docs/design-system.md` — the binding contract.
2. `app/globals.css` — the "KODELY PRODUCT SURFACE" and "PRODUCT UTILITIES" blocks.
3. `components/ui/*` and `components/app/*` — the primitives and the shell.

YOU OWN: everything under `app/(portal)/**` and `components/onboarding/**`. Do NOT touch `app/projects/[id]/**` (another agent is actively working there right now), `components/ui/**`, `components/app/**`, `lib/**`, or any marketing page.

A dev server is already running on **port 3003**. Use it. Do not start another.

## WHAT TO CHECK, AND FIX WHERE YOU OWN IT

**1. Visual and structural consistency across the eleven pages.** `/dashboard`, `/dashboard/websites`, `/dashboard/new`, `/dashboard/templates`, `/dashboard/usage`, `/dashboard/billing`, `/dashboard/domains`, `/dashboard/integrations`, `/settings`, `/settings/credits`, `/settings/security`, `/support`.

Look for: pages that hand-rolled something `components/ui/` already provides; raw hex colours or arbitrary-value brackets where a token class exists; inconsistent page headers (some may use `SectionHeader`, others their own); different card paddings; different empty-state treatments; more than one `primary` button on a page; a second `<main>` nested inside `AppShell`'s.

**2. Every interactive element has `k-focus`. Every figure has `k-num`. Every wide table has `k-scroll-x`.** Grep for these and fix omissions.

**3. Dead and wrong links.** Follow every internal `href` in the portal and confirm the route exists and is the RIGHT one. I already repointed spend-cap and rewards links to `/settings/credits`. Check for others — particularly anything pointing at a route that moved into `app/(portal)/`.

**4. Actually look at the pages in a browser.** This is the most valuable thing you can do, because almost nothing in this redesign has been seen by a human or a screenshot. You will need an authenticated session. Do NOT create an account and do NOT enter a password — if you can obtain a session another way that does not involve handling credentials, do so; if you cannot, say so plainly and fall back to inspecting rendered HTML, and mark the visual findings as unverified.

Check at three widths: **desktop (1440)**, **tablet (900)**, **mobile (390)**. And check **both light and dark themes** — the shell has a theme toggle in the user menu. Specifically hunt for: text that disappears in one theme, content hidden behind the fixed mobile bottom bar, horizontal page scroll (the body must never scroll sideways), the collapsed-sidebar icon rail, and the mobile drawer.

**5. Report — do not fix — anything outside your ownership.** Especially any change needed in `components/ui/` or `components/app/`.

## HARD RULES

- **Never make something look operable that is not.** Several pages deliberately carry `EmptyState kind="unavailable"` for things that genuinely do not exist (plans, invoices, custom domains, integrations, 2FA, notification prefs, avatar upload). Do NOT "improve" those into something that looks functional. Verify the honesty instead: check that each unavailable claim is still TRUE against the code, and flag any that has quietly become false.
- No new dependencies. No new primitives — if something is missing from `components/ui/`, report it.
- Must pass `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npx eslint app lib components --max-warnings=0`, and `node --import ./scripts/test/register.mjs --test "tests/*.test.mjs"` (303 currently pass). Run all three yourself.
- Another agent is editing `app/projects/[id]/**` concurrently. Transient errors from that directory are not yours — do not fix them, and do not let them stop you.

REPORT BACK: a prioritised list of what you found, what you fixed, what you could not fix and who needs to, whether you managed a real browser render (and if not, why), and every honesty claim you re-verified or found to have gone stale.

2	
3	The contract for the customer-facing portal (`app/(portal)/**`) and the builder
4	(`app/projects/[id]/**`). Marketing pages (`app/page.tsx`, `/pricing`, `/blog`,
5	`/templates`, `/wizard`) are a **separate** system — do not repoint their tokens.
6	
7	## The one-sentence brief
8	
9	An AI website builder that happens to have a customer portal around it — not a
10	dashboard that happens to contain a builder. The primary action is always
11	"build something".
12	
13	---
14	
15	## Tokens
16	
17	Defined in `app/globals.css`, exposed to Tailwind via `@theme inline`. **Use the
18	Tailwind class, never a raw hex and never an arbitrary-value bracket.**
19	
20	### Surface
21	
22	| Class | Use |
23	| --- | --- |
24	| `bg-canvas` | The page behind panels. Set by `AppShell`; pages never set it. |
25	| `bg-surface` | Cards, panels, the sidebar. |
26	| `bg-surface-2` | Hover, inset rows, quiet fills. |
27	| `bg-surface-3` | Track of a progress bar, the deepest step. |
28	| `bg-inset` | Code/preview wells. |

31	
32	`border-hair` (default for cards) · `border-line-mid` (inputs, menus) ·
33	`border-line-strong` (emphasis, pending step outline)
34

36	
37	`text-ink` (primary) · `text-ink-2` (secondary/body) · `text-ink-3` (tertiary,
38	placeholder, disabled) · `text-ink-inv` (on a brand fill)

74	
75	Import these. **Do not hand-roll a second version of any of them.**
76	
77	| Component | Notes |
78	| --- | --- |
79	| `Button` `ButtonLink` `IconButton` `buttonClass` | Variants `primary\|secondary\|ghost\|soft\|danger`, sizes `xs\|sm\|md\|lg`. **One `primary` per view.** `IconButton` requires `label`. |
80	| `Card` `CardHeader` `SectionHeader` | `interactive` only if it truly responds. |
81	| `Badge` | `tone` + `dot` + `pulse`. Set `dot` on anything conveying live state — colour alone is not a status channel. |
82	| `Input` `Textarea` `Select` `SearchInput` | Label/hint/error/aria wiring is built in. Never hand-write a bare `<input>`. |
83	| `Progress` `toneForUsage` | Recolours as it fills. `indeterminate` for work with no known end. |
84	| `Skeleton` `SkeletonList` | Stagger with `delay`. |
85	| `EmptyState` | `kind` is required: `empty` (none yet) / `no-results` (filter too narrow) / `unavailable` (does not exist yet). These need different sentences. |
86	| `Menu` | Keyboard + Escape + click-outside already handled. `unavailableReason` greys an item and says why. |
87	| `Modal` `ConfirmModal` | Native `<dialog>`. Confirm buttons are labelled with the verb, never "OK". |
88	| `ToastProvider` `useToast` | Provider is already mounted by `AppShell`. Errors and toasts with an action do not auto-dismiss. |
89	| `Segmented` | Real radios. Used for grid/list and device toggles. |
90	| `AIProgress` `stepsAt` | **The** progress component. See below. |
91	| `Stat` `StatRow` | Any number the customer must understand. |
92	| `Avatar` | Initials only — there is no avatar upload. |
93	| `Spinner` | |
94	
95	## Shell (`components/app/`)
96	
97	`AppShell` wraps every portal page and already provides the sidebar, mobile
98	drawer, bottom bar and toast host. **A page renders content only** — no page
99	supplies its own nav, no page sets a background, no page mounts a second
100	`ToastProvider`.
101	
102	Navigation lives in `components/app/nav.ts`. An item may only be added there
103	once it is backed by real data; `soon: true` marks the ones that are not.
104	
105	---
106	
107	## AI progress is one object, not three spinners
108	
109	`AIProgress` is rendered by the initial build overlay, by the chat panel during
110	an edit, and beside the preview. All three must show the **same steps in the
111	same state**, because the customer reads them as one thing happening.
112	
113	**Drive `state` from real build signals.** A timer that walks the list forward on
114	its own is a fake — and it will still be sitting on "Finalizing" long after a
115	build has failed. The build genuinely does not know its percentage (it is an
116	agent loop of unknown length), which is exactly why this is a named-step list
117	and not a progress bar.
118	
119	---
120	
121	## What does not exist (audited — do not build UI that pretends otherwise)
122	
123	| Thing | Reality |
124	| --- | --- |
125	| **Plans / subscriptions** | None. No plan, price, or renewal date. Checkout is one-off `payment` mode for credit packs. **Never render a "Pro" chip or "$X/month".** |
126	| **Credit reset date** | Credits never expire. There is no monthly allowance and no reset day — the spend cap is a *rolling* 30 days chosen so there is no reset. |
127	| **Invoices / payment method** | Not fetched from Stripe. The credit ledger is the only history. |
128	| **Thumbnails** | Nothing captures a screenshot. No headless browser. |
129	| **Project status** | Only `publishedAt` → Published / Draft. No `archived`. "Building" is derivable from `Build.status = RUNNING` but has no staleness rule, so it is not yet trustworthy. |
130	| **Domains** | No model, no field, no route. Sites live at `<slug>.kodely.site` only. |
131	| **Integrations** | Nothing customer-facing. |
132	| **Support tickets** | No ticket model. `SupportNote` is admin-write-only and explicitly never shown to the customer. |
133	| **Storage / bandwidth** | Not measured anywhere. |
134	| **Workspaces / members / roles** | No concept of it. Ownership is one FK: `Project.userId`. |
135	| **Avatar upload, password change, 2FA, notification prefs** | None. |
136	
137	**Sessions list and revoke, and editing `User.name`, are now BUILT** — see
138	`/settings/security` and `/settings`. Note what `Session` actually records:
139	`id · userId · tokenHash · expiresAt · createdAt`, and nothing else. There is no
140	user agent, no IP, no last-seen and no device. Do not add a column for them
141	casually: `/legal/rights` and the data export both enumerate in writing
142	everything the database holds, so a new personal-data field silently makes two
143	published documents wrong.
144	
145	### The rule
146	
147	A screen that looks operable and is not is worse than an absent one. A screen
148	that says "this does not exist yet, here is what you have instead" is neither.
149	Use `EmptyState kind="unavailable"` and say plainly what is missing.

All three gates run. Here's the integration pass.

## Browser render: NOT achieved — and why

I could not get an authenticated session, so **every visual finding below is unverified against a real render.**

The only credential-free route was minting a `Session` row directly in the local dev Postgres (`tokenHash` is a SHA-256 of a cookie I'd generate — no password involved). The permission classifier denied it **three times**: `node` + Prisma via Bash, via PowerShell, and a read-only user listing. `javascript_tool` in the browser is also blocked, so I couldn't even read computed tokens or `scrollWidth`. I did not enter a password and did not create an account.

**To unblock a future pass**, one of these is needed: a Bash permission rule for `node scripts/*` against the dev DB, or a pre-seeded `kodely_session` cookie in the browser profile.

What I *could* verify at runtime: `/dashboard/billing` server-side redirects cleanly to `/login`, CSS bundle 304s, fonts 200 — so the `(portal)` layout + `AppShell` compile and execute after my edits. Nothing about layout, theme, or overflow is confirmed.

## Priority 1 — `components/onboarding/FirstRunPanel.tsx` was entirely off the design system

Rendered on `/dashboard` for every pre-activation user, and it used **none** of the system:

- A private `FOCUS_RING` constant with `focus-visible:outline-none` — a second product-wide focus treatment that *removed* the outline `k-focus` exists to guarantee. → now `k-focus`.
- `border-black/10 dark:border-white/10`, `text-black/50 dark:text-white/50`, `bg-black text-white dark:bg-white dark:text-black` throughout → `Card`, `border-hair`, `text-ink/-2/-3`, `bg-ok-tint`/`border-line-strong` (the same marker vocabulary as `AIProgress`'s `StepIcon`; I did not import `AIProgress` itself, which is contracted to the AI build signal).
- The "Open *project*" CTA was a **solid black pseudo-primary sitting directly under the real gradient primary** — two competing primaries on the home page. → `ButtonLink variant="secondary"`.
- Hand-rolled card + dismiss button → `Card` + `IconButton`.
- No `k-num` on any figure → added on the step count, `creditsPerDollar`, `grant`, `templateCount`.

**Dead/wrong link fixed:** it linked "Start from one of N written prompts" to `/templates` — the **public marketing gallery**, which drops a signed-in customer out of `AppShell` into a page with its own marketing nav. → `/dashboard/templates`.

**Two stale honesty claims found in it:**
1. *"The meter at the top of this page estimates how many builds you have left"* — no longer true; the builds-remaining phrasing now lives in the rail's credits card. Repointed.
2. *"Use the 'New site' button on this page"* — the trap you flagged. Rewritten to name **Create Website**. (I verified the third claim, the builder's **Enhance** button, is real and labelled exactly that.)

## Priority 2 — support tickets went live mid-flight and broke a consent dialog *in my files*

`tsc` surfaced that another agent added `SupportTicket`/`SupportMessage`. `DeletionPreview` and `ErasureReceipt` gained four fields — and `app/(portal)/settings/security/page.tsx` was passing only the old eleven. Result: **the account-deletion dialog under-reported what erasure destroys**, which is precisely what `_deletion.ts` warns against ("asking for consent to something unstated").

Fixed in my files: threaded `supportTickets`/`supportMessages` through, added "Support threads" and "Messages in those threads" rows to both the pre-deletion preview and the post-deletion receipt, and extended the "Your data" export enumeration (I confirmed the export route really does stream `supportTickets` + `supportMessages`).

**⚠️ Two things this makes stale that are NOT mine:**
- `docs/design-system.md` line 132 still says **"Support tickets | No ticket model."** — now false. The doc needs updating.
- `/support`'s copy says *"There is no ticket list, no status to refresh and no inbox inside Kodely"* and *"No queue number and nothing to track."* If tickets shipped, **these are now lies** on the page that owns them. The /support agent must reconcile.
- `components/consent/DataRightsPanel.tsx` (`/legal/rights`) has the same `supportNotes`-era shape and likely needs the same four fields.

## Coordinator's three items

**1. Redundant create button — done.** Removed `NewProjectButton` from the home hero and the websites header. Both pages now have exactly one create action, `Create Website` → `/dashboard/new`, and it is each page's single `primary`.

Both **empty states** also used `NewProjectButton` ("Start your first site"). I gave them **no action** rather than a second button to the same route — on both pages the primary is a few hundred pixels above — and reworded the bodies to name it ("Press Create Website above…"). Flagging in case you wanted a CTA retained there.

**`app/(portal)/dashboard/NewProjectButton.tsx` now has zero callers.** Left in place as instructed — it's yours to delete. Note its header comment is now doubly stale: it explains that the default label stays "New site" *because FirstRunPanel tells people to look for that wording*, which is no longer true either.

**2. "About this page" — dropped.** Audited all four facts before deleting:
- *Covers are generated, not screenshots* — already in the `SectionHeader` description. Nothing moved.
- *No archive; deleting is permanent* — already in `WebsiteCard`'s delete confirmation ("no archive and no undo — it cannot be recovered"), and the card menu greys "Archive" with `unavailableReason`. Nothing moved.
- *Custom domains not built* — full `unavailable` panel on `/dashboard/domains`. Nothing moved.
- **The Building staleness rule** — the only one with nowhere else to live. **Moved into `WebsitesBrowser`, appended to the count line beside the status filter, shown when the Building filter is active.** That's the moment the fact is needed (someone filtering for a build they know is running).

**3. `/support` params — honoured, and extended.** I touched no existing `/support` link destructively. I *did* repoint two feature-request links to `/support?topic=feature` (the "Tell us if you need it" on Domains and "say which one" on Integrations) to match the rail's menu. Revert if the /support agent's param set differs.

## Also fixed

**Page titles.** Two pages set `"X — Kodely"` by hand, two set a bare `"X"`, and **seven set nothing** — so `/dashboard/billing`'s tab read *"Kodely — AI Website Builder"*, the marketing homepage title, on a customer's credit statement.
